findings.title: Inconsistent error propagation after CLI no-progress recovery
findings.body: At line 134, the code returns `return nil, result, err` for any error that doesn't contain 'CLI command made no progress'. However, the recovery logic at lines 122-131 already sets error to nil when recovery succeeds. This creates an inconsistent pattern: for CLI no-progress errors, recovery attempts are made and error is set to nil on success, but for other errors, the original error is returned immediately without any recovery attempts.
findings.evidence:
Step 1: Line 115 calls app.Harness, potentially returning error
Step 2: Line 121 checks if error contains 'CLI command made no progress'
Step 3: If yes, lines 122-131 attempt recovery and return with error=nil on success
Step 4: Line 134 returns `nil, result, err` for all other errors without any recovery attempts
Step 5: This creates inconsistent behavior - CLI no-progress errors get recovery attempts, other errors don't, even if they might be recoverable through the same mechanisms
findings.suggestion: Consider adding a general recovery mechanism for non-fatal errors before the fallback at line 134. This would ensure consistent recovery behavior across different types of harness failures, not just CLI no-progress errors.
